_doc: How each food is held and eaten (ULyudFoodSubsystem, Public/LyudFood.h). Frames: the palm's (cm): X along the fingers, Z out of the palm, origin the palm's middle; for the right hand +Y is the little finger's side, -Y the thumb's. stages: bite stage meshes /Game/Food/SM_Food_<id>_<k> (blender/food/build_food.py writes them in the palm's frame, so palm_loc/palm_rot stay 0); mouth_full/mouth_empty: the point that goes to the lips when whole and at the last bite (actor frame); mouth_fingers/mouth_palm: the palm's turn at the mouth in the look frame (forward, right, up) when it isn't across the mouth; bites: the share a click, a hold and each steady bite take; steady_every s; texture: the bite sound (crisp, soft, squeak, chewy, crunch); chew_seconds: chewing for the whole thing; wrapped: rustles out of the pocket. Foods not listed (or without mouth_full) are held by their plain look's size and bitten from the top.
